name: Neck rolls
description: Gentle neck mobility for a short break.
steps: Sit or stand with relaxed shoulders.
Draw a small, slow circle with your head.
Reverse direction and keep the movement controlled.

name: Shoulder circles
description: Simple shoulder mobility for desk or standing breaks.
steps: Stand or sit with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Roll both shoulders forward in smooth circles.
Switch direction while keeping your breath calm.

name: Standing thoracic rotations
description: An upper-back rotation exercise for short sessions.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms crossed.
Rotate your chest to one side without forcing the range.
Return to center and alternate sides at a steady pace.

name: Standing cat-cow
description: Spine mobility with no equipment or floor contact.
steps: Hands on your thighs with knees slightly bent.
Gently round your back and tuck your chin.
Lift your chest and lengthen your spine.

name: Hip circles
description: Controlled hip mobility for small indoor spaces.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hands on your hips and draw slow circles with your pelvis.
Reverse direction while keeping the movement smooth.

name: Ankle rocks
description: A short standing mobility sequence for the ankles.
steps: Stand near a wall or chair for support if needed.
Gently rock from your heels to your toes.
Slowly rotate each ankle before switching sides.

name: Wrist mobility
description: Quick wrist and hand mobility for screen breaks.
steps: Extend both arms forward with relaxed shoulders.
Draw slow circles with your wrists in one direction.
Reverse direction and gently open and close your hands.

name: Standing side bends
description: Lateral torso mobility that fits a small room.
steps: Stand with your feet firmly planted.
Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side.
Return to center and alternate sides with control.

name: Hamstring sweeps
description: Light posterior-chain mobility for micro-sessions.
steps: Step one heel forward with the toes lifted.
Hinge at your hips and sweep your hands toward your toes.
Rise back up and alternate legs at a calm pace.

name: Seated spinal twist
description: A chair rotation for short mobility breaks.
steps: Sit tall with your feet flat on the floor.
Gently rotate your chest toward one side.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

name: March in place
description: Low-impact cardio for a quick energy boost at home.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
March in place, lifting your knees comfortably.
Swing your arms naturally while keeping a steady rhythm.

name: Step jacks
description: A no-jump cardio variation for small spaces.
steps: Feet together and arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising both arms overhead.
Return and alternate sides at a lively pace.

name: Low-impact skaters
description: Lateral cardio with no jumping.
steps: Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Step one foot diagonally behind the other as your arm crosses over.
Alternate sides while keeping the movement light.

name: Front toe taps
description: Compact cardio with a steady rhythm.
steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Tap one toe forward and bring it back under your hips.
Alternate feet and add arm swings as you speed up.

name: Quick side steps
description: Cardio for small spaces with short lateral steps.
steps: Stand with feet under your hips and soft knees.
Take two steps toward one side.
Return the other way while keeping your torso upright.

name: Shadow boxing
description: Equipment-free cardio with controlled punches.
steps: Stand in a guard with staggered feet and hands near your chest.
Throw light punches forward, alternating arms.
Keep your elbows soft and move your feet gently.

name: Standing knee lifts
description: A simple cardio sequence with controlled knee lifts.
steps: Stand tall with your hands relaxed or slightly in front.
Lift one knee to waist height if comfortable.
Lower it and alternate sides at a steady pace.

name: Standing mountain climbers
description: A standing cardio variation with no floor contact.
steps: Stand tall with both arms extended forward.
Lift one knee while pulling the opposite elbow back.
Alternate sides while keeping the pace controlled.

name: Squat to reach
description: A short full-body cardio move with light squats.
steps: Feet slightly wider than your hips.
Lower into a shallow, comfortable squat.
Rise and reach both arms overhead before repeating.

name: Fast feet
description: High-intensity cardio for short bursts at home.
steps: Bend your knees with feet under your hips.
Take quick, light steps in place.
Keep your chest lifted and slow down when you need to.

name: Box breathing
description: A structured breathing exercise with equal phases.
steps: Breathe in through your nose for four counts.
Hold gently for four counts.
Breathe out for four counts and hold again for four.

name: 4-6 breathing
description: Paced breathing with a longer exhale.
steps: Sit or stand comfortably with relaxed shoulders.
Breathe in through your nose for four counts.
Exhale slowly for six counts and repeat.

name: Paced nasal breathing
description: A quiet nasal breathing practice for a short reset.
steps: Gently close your mouth and breathe through your nose.
Match each inhale and exhale to a comfortable count.
Keep the rhythm smooth without forcing it.

name: Physiological sigh
description: A short breathing pattern with two inhales and one exhale.
steps: Breathe in comfortably through your nose.
Add a small second inhale at the top.
Exhale slowly through your mouth and repeat calmly.

name: Equal breathing
description: A simple inhale-exhale rhythm for micro-sessions.
steps: Choose a comfortable count, such as four.
Inhale for that count without lifting your shoulders.
Exhale for the same count and continue steadily.

name: Extended exhale
description: A gentle breathing exercise with a longer release.
steps: Breathe in naturally through your nose.
Exhale slightly longer than your inhale.
Let each breath stay quiet and effortless.

name: Belly breathing
description: A foundational breathing practice with relaxed posture.
steps: Rest one hand on your belly if it feels comfortable.
Breathe in and let your belly expand gently.
Breathe out and let your belly fall naturally.

name: Shoulder-drop breathing
description: A breathing exercise paired with a gentle shoulder release.
steps: Breathe in and let your shoulders rise slightly.
Breathe out and let them lower with control.
Repeat at a calm pace without forcing it.

name: Triangle breathing
description: A three-phase breathing rhythm for short guided sessions.
steps: Breathe in for three or four counts.
Hold gently for the same count.
Breathe out for the same count and repeat.

name: Breath reset
description: A short breathing sequence with attention to posture.
steps: Standing or seated, notice your posture.
Take three slow breaths at a natural pace.
Release your jaw, hands, and shoulders as you continue.
